format: VaultMate counting cases. The plugin owns this folder; `npm run sync-contract` copies it to the Android project.
fallbackDateMeaning: Creation date of a note, used for an idea with neither a created date nor a date in the note name.

statements: Fresh thought written during an old brainstorm
Plan a surprise for a friend
Cuisiner un grand pot-au-feu le dimanche
Write the notes of the year
Un jardin partagé pour le quartier

reviewWithOnlyScheduledDate.line: Decision with only a scheduled date

plainTaggedIdeaLine.line: A plain line that carries the tag

groupsMeaning.fresh/waiting/wilting: Open ideas of 0-2, 3-14, more than 14 days, from the created date, else a date in the note name, else fallbackDate. A future date is fresh.
groupsMeaning.seeds: Open ideas tagged idea/<seedSubtag>; never in fresh, waiting or wilting.
groupsMeaning.overdue: Open decision or prediction whose review date is before today.
groupsMeaning.today: Open review due exactly today (also in week).
groupsMeaning.week: Open review due from today to six days ahead. Only the plugin shows it.
groupsMeaning.upcoming: Open review due seven days or more ahead. Only the plugin shows it.
groupsMeaning.undated: Open review without a review date. Only the plugin shows it.
